title: mp2t: Support files like BDAV M2TS with a header
description:
Blu-ray Disc Audio-Video uses a MPEG-2 Transport Stream variant that
puts a 4 byte header before each frame, instead of putting a trailer
such as other extensions do (for, e.g., FEC.) Such files generally
have the extension of .m2ts instead of .mp2t or .ts (.m2t is used
for either for 8.3 filename compatibility).

Have wiretap read such transport stream variants by allowing for
the possibility that there is a header instead of a trailer. Check
for the edge case where the header contains a spurious 0x47 sync byte.

Ping #19884.

A follow up would be extending packet-mp2t.c to dissect the header
bytes.
